claims.statement: gmmff uses Redis for distributed slot storage with TTL-based expiration, falling back to an in-memory store when Redis is not configured.

gmmff's STUN/TURN integration parses TURN URLs supporting both long-term credentials (username/password) and ephemeral credentials derived from a static secret per RFC 8489, converting them to pion/webrtc.ICEServer instances.
In local mode, gmmff uses the zeroconf library to publish and browse _gmmff._tcp services via mDNS for peer discovery on the same network, excluding self from results.
The schedule feature provides encrypted server-side transfers that store data on the file system (not Redis) using AES-256-GCM encryption and scrypt-based password protection.
